### Summary

kintera can read a reaction network in the input format of the KINETICS photochemistry code. Two `ctest` entries
check this reader on small inputs kept in the tree: the C++ program `test_kinetics_base` and the Python file
`test_kinetics_base.py`. A third group of cases runs a full Titan comparison against files that are not in the
tree. When those files are absent, the cases skip through `_external_titan_paths`
({{< code tests/test_kinetics_base.py _external_titan_paths >}}).
